content:
When you use the Google Cloud CLI or the REST API to make changes, the changes are initially
marked as pending until the operation is completed. You can use the gcloud CLI or the REST
API to check on the status of changes or get a history of changes.
An operation is completed (status: done) when Cloud DNS has successfully updated the
system that controls the servers. There might still be delays before all name servers are
updated.
